history.body: Hi, saw your Pearl Residences ad. We’re renting nearby and starting to look for our first place. Can share a bit more?

Of course. Pearl Residences’ main home type is 900 sq. ft., with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony—so there’s flexibility for a spare room or workspace. It’s in established Seberang Jaya, with connectivity toward Sunway Carnival Mall and Chai Leng Park. Since you’re looking for your first place, are you hoping to buy somewhere to live yourselves, or still exploring your options?
Yes, for ourselves. We’re still comparing a couple of places, but having an extra room sounds useful. Do you have a general starting price?

The dated 14 August 2026 package snapshot works out to an indicative RM301,760 on a listed RM328,000 base, for a specified podium-blocked category. That isn’t a confirmed current offer or all-in price; the exact unit, parking/accessory components and current package need confirmation. Since the extra room is useful to you both, a viewing could help you judge the 3-bedroom layout as you compare places. Would you like me to help arrange one?
The price is around what we had in mind, though we’d still need to check the total costs. My partner sometimes works from home, so the extra room could be useful. Could we look at the layout first?

Yes—the Type A is 900 sq. ft. with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The living, dining and kitchen areas are open-plan, with an entrance foyer and a small storage area; the layout avoids a long internal corridor. The extra room could give your partner a separate work-from-home space. I’ll request the approved floor plan so you can check the exact room placement. The total cost will need separate confirmation too—the RM301,760 figure was only an indicative calculation from a dated package snapshot, not a confirmed current all-in price. Once you’ve reviewed the plan, I’d recommend seeing the space in person to judge whether it works for you both.
Yes, please send the approved plan when it’s available. We’ll look at it together first, then decide if a visit makes sense.

Sure — I’ve requested the approved Type A plan, and it’s still pending. I’ll send it once it’s available so you and your partner can check the exact room placement, especially whether the third bedroom works as a separate workspace. Then you can decide whether an in-person visit makes sense.
